item.description: NEW DELHI: Delhi woke up to a chilly morning on Tuesday as the temperature dropped to 4 degrees Celsius, with a cold wave and dense fog continuing to affect the national capital, while air quality remained a concern with the overall Air Quality Index recorded in the very poor category. item.title: Indian markets open higher amid positive India-US trade cues, fresh tariff threat on trade with Iran

item.title: Cold Wave Tightens Grip on J&K as Temperatures Dip Further; Dense Fog Disrupts Life in Jammu
item.description: JAMMU: The minimum temperature in Jammu and Kashmir dropped further on Tuesday due to a clear night sky, intensifying the cold wave across the region. Srinagar city recorded a bone-chilling –4.9°C as the lowest night temperature. item.title: Earthquake of magnitude 3.5 hits Bageshwar in Uttarakhand
